mentions.name: PromptLibrary
mentions.description: A prompt library for organising prompts and making them accessible from multiple clients, including chatbots via a Chrome extension, CLIs, and IDE extensions. Prompts are stored once and can be retrieved anywhere; variables can be filled in to create variations of the same prompt, and prompts can have versions. A landing page is live, with general availability planned within about 10 days.
mentions.problem: The author wanted a library to store their own prompts once and retrieve them in multiple locations, such as trying a prompt in Claude Desktop and then loading it into Roo Code or Claude Code.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a PromptLibrary (https://promptlib.prashamhtrivedi.in/) to organise my prompts and make it accessible from multiple clients (Including chatbots (via chrome extensions), CLIs, IDE extensions amongst the few).
